import os, subprocess, torch, numpy as np
os.environ['TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST'] = '10.0a'
src = '/root/r9k/kernel.cu'
if not os.path.exists(src):
    print('MISSING', os.listdir('/root') if os.path.exists('/root') else None)
    raise SystemExit
K = open(src).read()
# (ii) helpers
helpers = '''__device__ __forceinline__ void prefetch_l2(const void* src, uint32_t bytes) {
  asm volatile("cp.async.bulk.prefetch.L2.global [%0], %1;" ::"l"(src), "r"(bytes) : "memory"); }
__device__ __forceinline__ float4 ldnc4(const float4* ptr) {
  float4 r;
  asm volatile("ld.global.nc.v4.f32 {%0,%1,%2,%3}, [%4];" : "=f"(r.x), "=f"(r.y), "=f"(r.z), "=f"(r.w) : "l"(ptr));
  return r;
}
'''
i = K.index('__device__ __forceinline__ void tma2d(')
K = K[:i] + helpers + K[i:]
# (i) W1 block surgery
s0 = K.index("  if (!(p.abl & 2)) {\n    constexpr int NQ = C_ / 128")
s1 = K.index("    mb_wait(sbar, 0);\n    const float4* lw4", s0)
tail = "  } else {\n    mb_wait(sbar, 0);\n  }\n"
s2 = K.index(tail, s1)
s3 = s2 + len(tail)
s4 = K.index("  if (nu > 0) {\n    mb_wait(cbar, 0);", s3)
s5 = K.index("  __syncthreads(); if (tid == 0) STAMP(1);\n", s4)
load_part = K[s0:s1]
convert_part = K[s1:s2]
stamp_line = K[s3:s4]
nu_block = K[s4:s5]
lp = load_part.replace("  if (!(p.abl & 2)) {\n", "", 1)
k = lp.index("#pragma unroll\n    for (int k = 0; k < MW1; k++) {")
decl, loop = lp[:k], lp[k:]
assert '__ldg(src + lane + 32 * j)' in loop
loop = loop.replace('__ldg(src + lane + 32 * j)', 'ldnc4(src + lane + 32 * j)')
new = decl + "  if (!(p.abl & 2)) {\n" + loop + "  }\n  if (lane == 0 && warp == 0) p.st[cta * 24 + 20] = gtime();\n" + nu_block + \
      "  if (!(p.abl & 2)) {\n" + convert_part + tail + stamp_line
K = K[:s0] + new + K[s5:]
# (iii) prefetch
mark = "  __syncthreads(); if (tid == 0) STAMP(1);\n"
pf = '''  if (tid < 32 && !(p.abl & 8)) {
    constexpr int MWp = (C_ >= 768) ? 2 : 1;
    const int Bz0 = min(P, p.T1), Ez0 = P - Bz0, Wt0 = Ez0 * 16 + Bz0 * 12;
    const bool idle0 = cta >= p.T1;
    const int nwc = idle0 ? 16 : 12;
    if (tid < nwc * MWp) {
      const int kk = tid / nwc, wl = tid - kk * nwc;
      const int wid = idle0 ? (cta - Bz0) * 16 + wl : Ez0 * 16 + cta * 12 + wl;
      const int u = wid + kk * Wt0;
      if (u < C4) prefetch_l2(p.w2 + (size_t)(u >> 2) * C4 + (u & 3) * C_, C_ * 4);
    }
  }
'''
K = K.replace(mark, mark + pf, 1)
d = '/root/r9k2'
os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
open(d + '/kernel.cu', 'w').write(K)
os.system('cp /root/r9k/bind.cpp ' + d + '/bind.cpp')
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load
m = load(name='r9st2', sources=[d + '/kernel.cu', d + '/bind.cpp'], extra_cuda_cflags=['-O3', '--use_fast_math', '-std=c++17'],
         extra_ldflags=['-lcuda'], build_directory=d, verbose=False)
dev = 'cuda'
flush = torch.empty(252 * 1024 * 1024 // 4, device=dev)
rows = [(2, 768, 7, 7), (8, 768, 7, 7), (16, 768, 7, 7), (32, 768, 7, 7), (16, 384, 14, 14)]
cols = [(20, 'ld'), (14, 'w1a'), (15, 'w1b'), (16, 'cb'), (17, 'cv'), (1, 'Aend'), (2, 's1'), (18, 'w2i'), (19, 'w2b'), (4, 'G1'), (7, 's2'), (9, 'end')]
for (B, C, H, W) in rows:
    g = torch.Generator(device=dev); g.manual_seed(1)
    rn = lambda *s: torch.randn(*s, device=dev, generator=g)
    x = rn(B, C, H, W); dww = rn(C, 1, 7, 7) / 7 ** .5; dwb = rn(C); lnw = torch.ones(C, device=dev); lnb = torch.zeros(C, device=dev)
    w1 = rn(4 * C, C) / C ** .5; b1 = rn(4 * C); gw = rn(4 * C) / (4 * C) ** .5; gb = rn(4 * C); w2 = rn(C, 4 * C) / (4 * C) ** .5; b2 = rn(C)
    out = torch.zeros_like(x)
    ws = torch.empty(m.wsb(B, C, H, W), dtype=torch.uint8, device=dev)
    st = torch.zeros(148 * 24, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
    for abl in [0, 8, 1, 2]:
        for rep in range(5):
            flush.zero_(); st.zero_(); torch.cuda.synchronize()
            m.run_st(x, dww, dwb, lnw, lnb, w1, b1, gw, gb, w2, b2, out, ws, st, abl)
            torch.cuda.synchronize()
        s = st.view(148, 24).cpu().numpy().astype(np.int64)
        t0 = s[:, 0].min()
        parts = []
        for (i, nm) in cols:
            v = s[:, i]; v = v[v > 0]
            if len(v) == 0: parts.append(nm + '=-'); continue
            v = (v - t0) / 1000.0
            parts.append('%s=%.1f' % (nm, np.median(v)) + ('/%.1f' % v.max() if i in (1, 2, 4, 9) else ''))
        durs = [np.median(s[:, i][s[:, i] > 0]) / 1000.0 for i in (11, 12, 13) if (s[:, i] > 0).any()]
        print(B, C, 'abl', abl, ' '.join(parts), 'pre/wait/post=', ['%.1f' % q for q in durs])

    out = torch.zeros_like(x)
    ws = torch.empty(m.wsb(B, C, H, W), dtype=torch.uint8, device=dev)
    st = torch.zeros(148 * 24, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)

            m.run_st(x, dww, dwb, lnw, lnb, w1, b1, gw, gb, w2, b2, out, ws, st, abl)
            torch.cuda.synchronize()

        t0 = s[:, 0].min()
        parts = []
